summary: The change raises the payments privileged idle timeout from 15 to 16 minutes in both the code (policy.py) and the approved parameter file (policy-params.json), directly violating the SES-1 parametric bound of ≤ 15. The exception EXC-0193 that was intended to authorize this deviation expired on 2026-10-27, one day before the review time of 2026-10-28, and therefore cannot excuse the deviation. All process obligations (ticket, independent approval, control-owner approval for the protected path, CI on the final commit) are satisfied, but the critical product obligation SES-1 and the exception governance obligation EXC-1 are both refuted, requiring rejection.
